context.summary: Robert describes building three Salesforce AI applications: Document Mess Detector, Ask Your Document, and My Org Butler. The account moves from text evaluation to retrieval from documents and agents that perform tasks, comparing implementation effort, model limitations, and the prospect of native Salesforce alternatives.

grouping_evidence.observation: Publisher announcement of Robert’s Salesforce Ben article; wrapper should be supporting provenance, not second work.
